title: Returns and volatilities of energy futures markets: Roles of speculative and hedging sentiments
summary: Positioning association lacks full executable specification; merged conceptually with existing COT boundaries.
about: Speculative/commercial-position sentiment and four energy futures.
findings: Indexed highlights report a CL reversal association and risk/volatility effects, without a complete net rule or release-clock bridge.
mechanism: Positioning may affect risk compensation and temporary pressure; no post-publication native profit reproduced.
build_on: No immediate trial or separate COT watch. Existing release-vintage and full-universe boundaries remain; an association alone does not justify a new threshold.
can_strategy_code_be_made: Needs full formulation, actual publication times and target construction; no sentiment rule inferred from highlights.
reading_scope: Indexed publisher abstract/highlights only, not full paper.
source_version: Rongda Chen, Bo Wei, Chenglu Jin and Jia Liu; International Review of Financial Analysis76,101748,July2021.
owned_input_mapping: Owned CL/NG prices and COT snapshots do not establish four-market, point-in-time source parity.
deeper_investigation: Move on; no repeat acquisition loop or new return definition.
